references.text: John 12:37 quoted directly from Isaiah 53:1 to explain why the people did not believe in Jesus, despite the many signs. Both texts focus on how faith in the revealed Lord was rejected by many.
Paul in Romans 10:16 quoted the same Isaiah 53:1 text as John 12:37 to emphasize that not everyone listened to the gospel. The connection lies in the question of faith in the revealed messenger.
